title: dactylorhiza majalis subsp. cordigera
intro: Dactylorhiza majalis subsp. cordigera, commonly known as the Marsh Orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza majalis subsp. cordigera include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in treating coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
